items.title: Gucci watchmaking division cuts 30 jobs in Switzerland
items.summary: Gucci Swiss Timepieces will eliminate about 30 of 95 roles at its Cortaillod (Neuchatel) factory as logistics functions move to Gucci's Trecate, Italy site. A consultation process runs to December 4; it is the second collective redundancy at the unit in two years after ~20-21 cuts in 2025.

items.title: Gucci supprime une trentaine de postes dans son usine horlogère de Cortaillod
items.summary: Union Unia confirmed roughly 30 jobs at risk at Gucci's Cortaillod watch plant. Union secretary Solenn Ochsner called the difficulties structural rather than cyclical and said cuts would not take effect before 2027 at the earliest; this is the second wave after 2025's reduction.

items.title: Horlogerie: Gucci supprime 30 postes à Cortaillod
items.summary: Local Swiss coverage of the Cortaillod watch division layoffs, noting the move follows Gucci's 2025 strategic repositioning of its watch business toward high-end haute horlogerie, and that around 20 jobs were already cut then.

items.title: Licenciements collectifs chez Gucci
items.summary: Regional radio report on the collective layoff announcement at Gucci Swiss Timepieces in Cortaillod, framing it alongside concurrent job cuts at watchmaker Zenith in Le Locle as a tough period for the Neuchatel watch valley.

items.title: C'era una volta Gucci: dalla gloria del lusso alla svalutazione del marchio
items.summary: Investigative piece (reported via Corriere della Sera's Donatella Polito) on Gucci's Italian subsidiary accounts showing a 3.2 billion euro loss in the 2025 financial statements, driven mainly (~90%) by a brand-value writedown rather than cash losses, as revenue nearly halved over three years.

items.title: Kering stock faces lower Gucci outlook in Goldman Sachs report
items.summary: Goldman Sachs cut its Q4 forecast for Gucci's organic sales to a 4.3% decline from a previously expected 1% decline, keeping investor focus on the brand's stalled turnaround under Demna and pressuring Kering shares.

items.title: Kering stock: Goldman Sachs cuts Gucci forecast for Q4
items.summary: Follow-up wire update reiterating Goldman's downgraded Q4 outlook for Gucci and noting Kering shares trading around 171.87 euros, with Gucci's recovery pace still the dominant swing factor for the stock.

items.title: Mariah Carey Checks In for Christmas in Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: WWD covers Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, built around her 1994 hit and promoting bags including the Starlet and GG Marmont plus Horsebit loafers.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign
items.summary: Coverage of social-media backlash to Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday ad; viewers on Instagram/TikTok called it cold, outdated and 'depressing', comparing its mood to American Horror Story rather than a festive campaign, with some praise reserved for Carey's styling.

items.source: Instagram/TikTok public comments (aggregated via press coverage)
items.title: Public comment thermometer on Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday ad
items.summary: Representative public comments captured from the campaign's social posts: "This feels like if JCPenney was trying to be luxury," "Cold is the perfect word," and "It was emotionless. Disappointing." Mixed with some praise for Carey's wardrobe.

items.title: Gucci Discount Strategy Puts Pressure On Luxury Rivals; Louis Vuitton Isn't Following
items.summary: Analysis of Gucci's unannounced price cuts on select handbags, sneakers and RTW (e.g. the Padlock bag down ~30% in France, sneakers from EUR800 to EUR560-595), framed as breaking a long-standing luxury-pricing taboo while Louis Vuitton holds firm.

items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: UK trade coverage detailing unannounced Gucci price adjustments across sneakers, handbags and ready-to-wear in Europe, following thirteen consecutive quarters of sales declines; prices were quietly lowered online over the summer rather than formally announced.

items.title: Gucci baisse le prix de certains sacs face au recul des ventes
items.summary: French-language report confirming the Padlock bag price drop in France from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450 (~30%), with Kering describing it as a targeted correction limited to certain discontinued seasonal items rather than a broad repricing.

items.title: Gucci lowers prices: Luca de Meo's strategy
items.summary: Italian trade outlet nss magazine examines whether Gucci's price cuts reflect a deliberate repositioning under Kering CEO Luca de Meo, questioning whether discounting resolves or deepens the brand's desirability problem.

items.title: Gucci Brings Latest Retail Concept to the U.K. Via Harrods
items.summary: Gucci's relocated womenswear boutique at Harrods, London debuts the brand's new Demna-era store concept for the first time in the UK -- a 1,170 sq ft space drawing on Italian Renaissance palazzo spatial logic, the second global location after the Paris Avenue Montaigne flagship.

items.title: Gucci's watch division will cut 30 jobs in Switzerland / relocated Harrods boutique takes new concept to UK
items.summary: Trade-wire summary bundling the Harrods new-concept boutique opening with the parallel Swiss watch division job-cut news, both dated to the same week and illustrating Gucci's split narrative of retail investment alongside cost-cutting.

items.title: Gucci Sets Up New Business Units' Organization
items.summary: Gucci restructures into business units with industry veterans Monica Ulmi and Marco Semeghini (both Gucci alumni from the 1990s-2000s, later at Ferragamo/Versace) joining as senior advisers based between Milan and Florence, working alongside Demna and CEO Francesca Bellettini.

items.title: Gucci S/S 2027 Milan - forum thread
items.summary: Ongoing TheFashionSpot community thread on Gucci's Demna-era Milan shows; members continue to debate the commercial vs. creative direction of the house. Included as the EU priority-A community source's most active Gucci thread; note this origin date is outside the 72h window and is logged for coverage transparency rather than freshness.

items.title: Gucci LACMA Art+Film Gala post
items.summary: Official Gucci X account post on brand ambassadors Tyriq Withers and Quen Blackwell attending the 2026 LACMA Art+Film Gala, part of the brand's cultural-patronage activation calendar; counted as official brand activation rather than organic buzz.

items.source: YouTube (search aggregation / WWD reporting on Bernstein note)
items.title: Demna's Runway Debut at Gucci Was 'More Good Than Bad,' Says Bernstein
items.summary: Sell-side analyst commentary (Bernstein) on Demna's first Gucci runway, cited here as proxy for continued SNS/analyst chatter referencing the debut months later; dated outside the 72h window, retained only as context for the still-circulating YouTube reaction-video genre, not as a fresh signal.
